properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities. The check divides the way the capability does, which is the point of it: the three STRUCTURAL criteria (traceable, has-a-check, recorded-contradiction) get ordinary deterministic tests with fixtures, and those are the ones worth building first. The four SEMANTIC criteria cannot be unit-tested for correctness — a test asserting "this vague requirement was flagged" only proves the fixture was flagged — so what must be pinned there is the GUARD: a quality complaint never edits a requirement, never changes its status, and is surfaced as a question rather than a verdict. Whether the semantic judgements are any good is a trials question, and the honest place to answer it is a real corpus with a human disagreeing.
